description: Calibration manifest for INT16 bundle v5. Covers 6 content types for weighted 99.9th-percentile activation statistics aggregation.

clips.name: daylight_outdoor
clips.description: High dynamic range, strong spatial gradients, typical surveillance/dashcam

clips.name: indoor_studio
clips.description: Low noise, predictable activations, controlled lighting

clips.name: sports_motion
clips.description: Large inter-frame differences, high entropy, fast motion vectors

clips.name: night_dark
clips.description: Low-light, outlier activation tails — known to fail strict PSNR gates

clips.name: talking_head
clips.description: Uniform regions, low inter-frame entropy, typical video conferencing

clips.name: animation
clips.description: Saturated colors, sharp edges, no film grain, synthetic content
